prompt:
A desktop app screen, landscape 16:10, rendered edge to edge as the screen itself (no browser window, no device frame, no desk). The app is "Tagalong", a crew of AI pets that work together in a small office. Screen: "Crew Office".

Layout, region by region:
1. Top bar, full width, about 7% of height: coral red plastic-coloured bar (#E8505B) with the title "Tagalong HQ" at left in a clean sans-serif; centre a standard text input with placeholder text "@Bolt review this PR"; right a white "Assign" button.
2. Left rail, about 18% width, deep plum (#2E2A3A): heading "Crew"; four rows, each a small square pea-green LCD tile (#CAD7B0) holding a tiny 1-bit dark-green pixel-art creature, then the name in a small pixel font and the role and status in a clean sans: "Scout · Generalist · At desk", "Ink · Writer · In Room 2", "Bolt · Backend engineer · Working", "Sage · Researcher · Needs you" (Sage's row has a small amber "!" icon plus the words "Needs you").
3. Centre, about 52% width: one large recessed pea-green LCD screen (#CAD7B0, dark ink #26301F, visible fine dot-matrix texture) showing a top-down 1-bit pixel-art office: four desks with tiny pixel pets, and two walled meeting rooms labelled "ROOM 1" and "ROOM 2" in pixel type; three pixel pets sit around the table in Room 2 with a pixel speech bubble. The LCD is framed by a rounded coral plastic bezel, like a 1990s virtual pet toy.
4. Right panel, about 30% width, light warm grey: heading "Meetings"; a list with "Launch blog post · Room 2 · Live" (selected) and "CI is failing · Ended"; below, a chat thread with avatar dots and messages: "Sage: Ink, can you tighten the intro to two sentences?", "Ink: Done. It now leads with what users get.", "Sage: Pixel, can you make a hero image?"; at the bottom a thin meter labelled "4 of 12 calls" and a text input "Join and type…".

Style: a clean, premium modern desktop app; standard controls; the toy-like LCD and candy plastic appear only in the pet screens and the coral shell. Body text in a crisp humanist sans at readable size. Aligned grid, consistent spacing, real hierarchy.
